summary: Iteration 7 QA of the student-area enhancements (auto admission no, gender dropdown, phone dial-code fields, class/section/subject filters, portal login creation, Student Portal). Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py — 21/21 pass (next-admission-no format+uniqueness+RBAC, /students/filter class/section/subject/search/pagination/RBAC, portal-user create/duplicate/404/validation, student login + /portal/me data + RBAC, gender & dial-code phone persistence). Frontend: full wizard flow, filters, edit-gender, portal login dialog, student portal, and regressions (bulk import, enroll-existing, delete, search, teacher, platform admin, class hub) all verified via Playwright. One real defect found: the Student Portal route is /portal-coming-soon, not /portal.

minor.issue: Deleting a student does NOT delete its linked portal user. The orphan student user can still log in successfully; GET /api/portal/me then returns 404 'No student profile linked'. Cascade-delete (or block delete) the portal user.

Deleting a student-role user leaves student.has_portal_access=true / portal_email set, so the Students row keeps showing Portal=Yes and the 'Create portal login' action stays permanently blocked with 'already has a portal login'. No revoke/reset path exists in UI or API.

Section options for the Students filter bar are institution-wide and not scoped to the selected Class, so users can pick a section that cannot exist for the chosen class (returns 0 rows). Labels come through as 'A (Grade 6)' in the filter dropdown.

ui_bugs.issue: Student Portal is mounted at '/portal-coming-soon' instead of '/portal'. Student login lands on https://<host>/portal-coming-soon and navigating directly to /portal renders the 'Page not found' screen — deep links/bookmarks broken and the URL text is misleading. Spec requires /portal (or keep a redirect from the old path).

issues: Section dropdown lists every section with a '(Grade 6)' suffix and is not filtered by the selected class

No visible issue: profile card, 3 stat cards (Attendance 100% 1/1 days, Published Results 1, Class Grade 6 / Section A) and Results table (Unit Test 1 / Mathematics / 42 of 50) render correctly; theme toggle and Sign out work

action_items: Rename the student portal route to /portal (keep roleHome in sync; optionally redirect /portal-coming-soon -> /portal).
Cascade portal-user deletion when a student is deleted, and add a way to revoke a portal login (reset has_portal_access/portal_email/user_id).
Optionally scope the Section filter options to the selected Class.
critical_code_review_comments: StudentsPage.jsx: GENDER_OPTS constant (line 47) is dead code — editFields redefines the same options inline (DRY).

PhoneField.jsx parses the incoming value only on mount (empty dependency array), so an externally changed value (e.g. loading an existing record into a reused dialog) will not re-sync the dial code/number.
PhoneField COUNTRIES has duplicate dial code '+1' (US and Canada); shadcn Select dedupes by value so selecting Canada shows United States — harmless but the Canada entry is unreachable.
There is no single-item GET route (GET /api/res/students/{id} returns 405); verification/tests must go through the list/filter endpoint. Consider adding a detail endpoint.
server.py is 1103 lines — consider splitting into routers (students, users, portal, academics).

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all flows pass except portal route path)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified this iteration: admission generator returns GH-2026-0001 and increments when taken; gender select has exactly Female/Male/Others (wizard + edit dialog, persists); PhoneField strips non-digits and persists '+44 9876543210' / '+91 77009001'; class filter, section filter (option label 'A (Grade 6)'), subject filter (Mathematics -> 0 rows / 'No records yet' — EXPECTED, no offerings) and Clear all work; portal login dialog prefills from student.email (empty for Aarav since he has no email) and second attempt shows info toast 'This student already has a portal login'; student login lands on /portal-coming-soon (route naming bug) and /portal/me returns attendance 100% + 1 published result; students are correctly blocked from /app/* (redirect to /access-denied). Auth playbook: bcrypt hashes are $2b$, CORS_ORIGINS is an explicit origin with allow_credentials=True, brute-force lockout confirmed (5x401 then 429). NOTE: when switching accounts in Playwright, clear cookies first or /login auto-redirects and detaches inputs. Also section filter options must be matched exactly ('All sections' contains 'A').
rca_of_the_issue: Portal route: App.js registers the StudentPortal element under path '/portal-coming-soon' and LoginPage.roleHome returns the same placeholder path for non-admin/non-teacher roles, so there is no '/portal' route at all (React Router falls through to the NotFound catch-all). Orphan portal user: POST /students/{id}/portal-user writes a users doc plus student flags, but DELETE /res/students/{id} is the generic resource delete which knows nothing about the linked user, and DELETE /users/{id} does not clear the student's has_portal_access — the two records can drift in either direction.
